channel.title: Great Ouse Ways
channel.itunes:author: Howard Osborne
channel.description:
The source-to-sea audio companion for the Great Ouse.

For 150 miles, the Great Ouse meanders through Middle England and you can follow its route by walking the Ouse Valley Way.

I've met all sorts of people on the way from rangers to river rinsers. You can listen to the conversations we had along the way.

More details are available including a map on the Great Ouse Ways website
